scope: Conditional ideal resource throughput at1.40GHz; not a measured clock, runtime prediction, or attribution of the measured slowdown
interpretation: Native V and Sum4 leave the tensor/exp2 work counts unchanged. Tensor and score-exp2 throughput floors are equal for FP8 D128 under these peaks. Shortening a sum dependency does not lower either resource-work floor. Additional scalar issue and checksum/PRMT dependencies can offset improved overlap; component timings must decide. Do not add overlapping resource floors or multiply static branch-containing loop sizes into measured cycles.
